sourceTitle: Inkle and Yarico: An opera, in three acts
description: "Inkle and Yarico: An opera, in three acts" by George Colman is a comic opera first staged in 1787. When English trader Inkle is shipwrecked in the West Indies, an Indian maiden named Yarico saves his life and they fall in love.
